_comment: ngsolve contact#2 (IfPos(-gap,1,0) is the active-set indicator; `gap < 0` fails at expression construction). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh 0.05, signed gap y-0.3. All four orderings <, <=, > and >= raise TypeError, the < case with exactly the text the claim quotes, and the wording the claim says does not exist ('CoefficientFunction comparison') is absent from all of them. The failure happens with no BilinearForm in scope at all, which is the claim's point about construction rather than assembly. Added control: == does NOT raise -- it returns a plain Python bool -- so an agent probing 'does comparison work on a CF?' with == gets a misleading yes. IfPos(-gap,1,0) is then shown to be a real indicator: its integral is 0.299435 against the exact 0.3 of the region below the threshold, and it partitions the domain with its complement to 1e-9. Mutation: comparing a float instead of the CF removes the TypeError and the fixture fails on lt_raises and lt_message_literal.
